# About This Site

Welcome! This is a Quarto dashboard project for **PMAP 8551/4551, Spring 2026**.

Here, you can explore penguin data from **Palmer Station, Antarctica**, interactive plots, and maps.

------------------------------------------------------------------------

## Fun Fact

Did you know that **Adelie penguins** can dive up to 175 meters underwater? 🐧

------------------------------------------------------------------------

## Play with the Data

You can even make a tiny interactive plot here:

\`\`\`{r} library(plotly)

# Count penguins by island

island_counts \<- penguins %\>% group_by(island) %\>% summarise(count = n())

plot_ly(island_counts, x = \~island, y = \~count, type = "bar", color = \~island)
